description: Allocation of land at Kamburupitiya to the National Housing Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development to allocate the block of land at the Kamburupitiya 'Gam Udawa' site utilized for the relocation of families displaced due to the Gam Udawa -1991, to the National Housing Development Authority (NHDA) by the Urban Development Authority (UDA), to execute the individual deeds of transfer to the displaced occupants, was approved by the Cabinet.
